$comment: Executable PR claims (Reality Control). scripts/detect-contradictions.mjs verifies refs exist on disk.

claims.assertion: First / per-beat midpoint / final frames extract deterministically from an assembled mp4 and produce a contact sheet.

Critic output is clamped to a fixed defect registry: severities come from the registry never the model, any block finding forces repair, unknown codes drop with a warning, critic failure yields a SKIPPED verdict rather than a fabricated one.
The pipeline hook is gated by RENDERED_QA_ENABLED (default OFF - prod unchanged); the operator endpoint evaluates on demand and never changes job status.
